Bad Bunny ultimately earned the respect of the entire locker room through his stellar in-ring performances at events like WrestleMania 37, the Royal Rumble, and Backlash.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown 9/4/2026 review and reaction
stories.tldr: The September 4, 2026 episode of WWE SmackDown focused on finalizing the build for Sunday Night's Main Event and setting up matches for next week's show in Mexico City. The pre-taped broadcast featured a main event where CM Punk successfully defended his Undisputed WWE Championship against Johnny Gargano. Reviewer Daisy Ruth shared her thoughts on the highs and lows of the night, including a heavily criticized backstage war of words between Nikki Bella and Paige. On the positive side, the review highlighted the newly formed team of Charlotte Flair and Tatum Paxley securing their first victory together.

stories.title: Updated full list of WWE NXT roster
stories.tldr: This comprehensive report provides an up-to-date and meticulously maintained roster for WWE NXT, addressing common inaccuracies found on other platforms. It details the complete lineups for the men and women divisions, active tag teams, prominent stables, and non-wrestlers currently with the brand. Additionally, the directory outlines essential personnel behind the scenes, including the broadcast team, coaches, strength and conditioning staff, and executive leadership.

stories.title: WWE star reverts back to former character on SmackDown
stories.tldr: Johnny Gargano made a dramatic return on SmackDown in his hometown of Cleveland, Ohio, reverting to his former Johnny Wrestling persona after months of inactivity and backstage depression. Prompted by Undisputed WWE Champion CM Punk, Gargano stepped up to accept a main event title match and used his classic Rebel Heart entrance theme. Although he came up short against Punk, the emotional return and social media reaction have fans hopeful for a fresh start for both Gargano and his wife Candice LeRae under the Triple H creative era.

stories.title: Match card announced for WWE SmackDown vs. Raw brand event
stories.tldr: With dedicated brand warfare premium live events like Survivor Series currently utilizing WarGames, a fantasy SmackDown versus Raw event offers a fun novelty for modern WWE. General Managers Adam Pearce and Nick Aldis rarely maintain long-term hostility, but a conceptual cross-brand card allows for dream matches that transcend current roster boundaries. Featured bouts in this hypothetical lineup include generational lucha libre stars, Bloodline family dynamics, unfinished women division business, and an ultimate four way main event.

stories.title: WWE considering resurrecting retired Premium Live Events in 2027
stories.tldr: With the WWE calendar rapidly expanding and featuring dozens of events across its main rosters and developmental brands, speculation is growing about bringing back classic Premium Live Events for 2027. Fans could potentially see the return of nostalgic concepts like Cyber Sunday, King of the Ring, Evolution, and Insurrextion to the modern schedule. While the current calendar is already packed, these retired brands offer unique opportunities for fan engagement and international expansion.

stories.title: WWE reportedly interested in signing former AEW Tag Team Champions
stories.tldr: With WWE tag team divisions needing reinforcement following recent roster shifts, the company is reportedly eyeing several former AEW Tag Team Champions. Potential targets include The Acclaimed, whose contracts expire in October, and Private Party, who have faced previous contract speculation and injuries. Additionally, FTR rounds out the list as their contract option year approaches, potentially offering WWE a chance to bring the veteran duo back.

stories.title: Danhausen and Gunther cross paths in WWE segment
stories.tldr: Danhausen and GUNTHER recently crossed paths on SmackDown in an unexpected backstage segment where Danhausen mistakenly referred to The Ring General as GOONER. This interaction has sparked speculation about a potential comedic pairing akin to Danhausen's past partnership with HOOK. While GUNTHER remains focused on dominant championship pursuits, creative opportunities exist to explore entertaining character dynamics and house show programs between the two contrasting stars. Blending their unique personas could yield significant comedic and storytelling mileage for WWE, much like previous lighthearted pairings in the company.

stories.title: WWE partners with Atlanta strip club for Sunday Night's Main Event merchandise
stories.tldr: WWE has announced a surprising merchandise collaboration with the famous Atlanta strip club Magic City ahead of Sunday Night's Main Event. The collection features a t-shirt and hoodie adorned with the club's logo alongside WWE branding and a cheeky peach graphic. This crossover promotion coincides with the September 6 live event at State Farm Arena, which features a loaded match card including high-profile bouts and rapper Lil Yachty's in-ring debut.

stories.title: WWE stars set to join new Triple H-led faction
stories.tldr: Amidst ongoing speculation about a corporate power struggle between the TKO board and Triple H's creative team, fantasy booking suggests four major WWE stars could align with Triple H. CM Punk, Seth Rollins, Cody Rhodes, and Roman Reigns are highlighted as the ideal representatives for the wrestling side against corporate interference. This potential faction warfare could finally pay off lingering feuds and teased matches from recent WrestleMania seasons.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown start time and viewing information
stories.tldr: WWE SmackDown broadcasts live tonight from Cleveland, Ohio, starting at 8pm Eastern time with a loaded lineup ahead of Sunday Night's Main Event. The show features fallout from Sami Zayn interfering in last week's WWE Title contender match, along with Cody Rhodes addressing the fans before his clash with Randy Orton. Fans can also look forward to Giulia making her rescheduled debut against Blake Monroe and a tag team match pitting Shinsuke Nakamura and Kyoki against The Miz and Kit Wilson.

stories.title: Royce Keys and OTM reveal new WWE stable name '946'
stories.tldr: Royce Keys and OTM members Bronco Nima and Lucien Price have officially named their new WWE heel stable 946. In a newly released digital vignette, Keys explained that the moniker represents the Oakland, California ZIP code where he and Nima grew up. Emphasizing that their alliance is built on loyalty rather than family, Keys and his group delivered another stern warning to the Raw roster that nobody is safe.

stories.title: Chelsea Green cleared for in-ring action on WWE SmackDown
stories.tldr: WWE Women's Champion Chelsea Green has officially received medical clearance to return to the ring following her orbital bone injury. During a recent episode of SmackDown, General Manager Nick Aldis announced she is cleared to compete as long as she wears a protective face mask. Nia Jax immediately stepped up to challenge her, leading to an official title match booked for next week in Mexico City. Jax also managed to rip the mask off Green during a tense post-match confrontation.

stories.title: Matt Cardona breaks down exact moment he tore triceps during WWE Main Event taping
stories.tldr: Following news that he and Chelsea Green are planning for the future, Matt Cardona has now shared footage of the exact moment he tore his triceps during an August 21 WWE Main Event taping against Kit Wilson. Cardona noted that the injury occurred on a routine second-rope dropkick and was confirmed during subsequent spots like a clothesline and baseball slide. Having already undergone successful surgery, Cardona has officially begun his rehabilitation and made it clear that his ultimate goal of becoming WWE World Champion remains unchanged.

stories.title: Blake Monroe responds to AEW star Toni Storm's past promo
stories.tldr: Blake Monroe is preparing for her delayed SmackDown in-ring debut against Giulia this week. Ahead of the match, an old scathing promo from Toni Storm during their AEW days resurfaced online. In the clip, Storm predicted that Monroe would face a lifetime of mediocrity and never reach the highest level of success. Monroe quickly fired back on social media, dismissing the scripted remarks and declaring her intentions to become a world champion and win everything in WWE.

stories.title: Blake Monroe shows off battle damage following attack by Giulia on SmackDown
stories.tldr: Blake Monroe and Giulia were finally set to collide on SmackDown, but their long-awaited match once again devolved into a violent pre-match brawl before the opening bell. After Monroe dismissed her in a backstage interview, Giulia blindsided her and delivered a brutal beating that ended with an Arrivederci down the entrance ramp. Monroe later took to social media to display the severe physical aftermath of the attack, sharing photos of deep back scratches and a heavy jaw wrap. With two scheduled encounters now ruined by uncontrollable violence, these rivals have made it clear they cannot coexist without trying to tear each other apart.

stories.title: WWE interested in signing AEW star Anthony Bowens
stories.tldr: WWE is actively eyeing Anthony Bowens as his AEW contract approaches its October 1 expiration. Meltzer reports that internal interest within WWE is strong regarding the former tag team champion. This development follows previous history, as Bowens nearly signed with WWE back in 2019 before ultimately joining AEW in 2020.

stories.title: Bully Ray predicts returning star will interfere at Sunday Night's Main Event
stories.tldr: Hall of Famer Bully Ray predicts that the recently cleared Bronson Reed will interfere in the upcoming match between Bron Breakker and Oba Femi at Sunday Night's Main Event. Speaking on Busted Open Radio, Ray suggested that Reed could attack both competitors to establish himself as the true future of the company, potentially aligning with Paul Heyman. While a non-finish protects both rising stars, analysts note that Femi could absorb a loss if a definitive winner is needed.

stories.title: Opinion on WWE and TKO's continued focus on celebrity appearances
stories.tldr: TKO is aggressively pushing mainstream celebrity integration into WWE programming as part of its commercial growth strategy. Recent examples include Lil Yachty stepping into the ring at Sunday Night's Main Event, upcoming musical performances being tested by Quavo, and controversial past angles involving Pat McAfee and sports crossover stars. While management believes these stunts secure outside media coverage, critics argue they often disrupt ongoing storylines and rarely resonate with traditional wrestling fans.

stories.title: Ticket sales update for WWE Worlds Collide 2026 in Rosemont
stories.tldr: WWE Worlds Collide 2026 at the Allstate Arena in Rosemont has distributed 9,792 tickets, gaining 241 new sales in recent days. The event currently holds a lead of over two thousand tickets compared to its direct same-state competitor, AEW All Out, which takes place on the same night in Hoffman Estates. With both shows running head-to-head in Illinois on September 26, ticket movement for both promotions continues to be a major focal point.

stories.title: Hechicero comments on CMLL World Heavyweight Title match vs Eddie Kingston
stories.tldr: CMLL World Heavyweight Champion Hechicero successfully defended his title against Eddie Kingston in the main event of the August 28 Viernes Espectacular at Arena Mexico, but the bout received a mixed response and noticeable boos from the live crowd. Dave Meltzer notably gave the match a 1.5-star rating and detailed issues regarding crowd fatigue, pacing, and Kingston's brawling style not resonating with the Arena Mexico audience. Speaking with Mas Lucha Jr., Hechicero acknowledged that they failed to establish the necessary emotional connection with the fans, attributing it to how things were presented rather than a clash of styles. Hechicero defended Kingston's overall in-ring quality and noted that the exact same match could receive a completely different reaction in another city, country, or card placement.

stories.title: El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr talks WWE Raw/SmackDown pressure and AAA training
stories.tldr: El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr. recently opened up about his experiences following WWE's acquisition of AAA, discussing how the intense pressure of competing on Raw and SmackDown left him physically and mentally exhausted. Despite the heavy demands of the cameras and backstage environment, he expressed immense gratitude for the opportunity, particularly highlighting his dream match against Dragon Lee and his bout against Carmelo Hayes. Additionally, he revealed that AAA talent regularly travel to Orlando to train at the WWE Performance Center once a month to adapt to the company's broadcast style and elevate their overall performances for global audiences.

stories.title: Zelina wins House of Glory debut match following WWE exit
stories.tldr: Formerly known as Zelina Vega in WWE, Xelina successfully returned to the ring at House of Glory's Fallout event in Los Angeles on September 4. In a high-stakes three-way match against Shayna Baszler and Brittnie Brooks, she secured the victory by hitting a Code Red on Baszler. This bout marked her first competition and win since her recent departure from WWE. Now operating under her new ring name in a new promotion, Xelina has immediately established strong momentum for the next chapter of her professional wrestling career.

stories.title: Rey Fenix accepts AAA World Cruiserweight Championship challenge
stories.tldr: Rey Fenix has officially agreed to defend his AAA World Cruiserweight Championship against Ricky Saints on the September 11 episode of SmackDown in Mexico City. The match follows weeks of intense trash talk where Saints repeatedly provoked the champion and accused him of dodging title defenses while focusing on Roman Reigns. After enduring numerous backstage interruptions, Fenix finally accepted the challenge to settle their rivalry inside the ring.

stories.title: Six-man tag team match set for AAA on Fox broadcast
stories.tldr: A high-profile six-man tag team match has been officially announced for the upcoming September 5 broadcast of AAA on Fox. Fresh off his AAA Latin American Championship victory at Ola de Calor, La Parka will team up with El Fiscal and Mr. Iguana to face the formidable trio of Los Vipers members Histeria and Taurus, alongside Dinamico. Fans can catch the action on Saturday at 8pm on Fox and Fox One, with live results coverage provided weekly.

stories.title: Amazing Red reflects on his career and influence on pro wrestling
stories.tldr: Former TNA star and future Hall of Famer Amazing Red recently reflected on his massive influence on professional wrestling during a podcast appearance. Despite creating numerous innovative moves, Red struggled to accept his overall impact until a heartwarming backstage experience at TNA Slammiversary 2026. Alongside his cousins and friends, Red revolutionized modern wrestling styles by using action figures to invent iconic maneuvers that are still widely used today by top stars.

stories.title: AEW wrestler Josh Alexander and Scott D'Amore leading Maple Leaf Pro school
stories.tldr: Scott D'Amore and AEW star Josh Alexander are spearheading the relaunch of the legendary Can-Am Dojo as the new MLP Academy, set to open in October 2026 in Windsor, Ontario. D'Amore will serve as general manager and Alexander as head coach of the state-of-the-art 4,000-square-foot facility, which aims to train aspiring wrestlers in both in-ring skills and the business side of the industry. The school builds on the legacy of the original dojo that produced top-tier talent like Rhino, the Motor City Machine Guns, and Bobby Roode. Meanwhile, Maple Leaf Pro Wrestling is also gearing up for its upcoming Northern Rising pay-per-view event on October 3.

stories.title: Editorial on the importance and impact of independent wrestling
stories.tldr: Independent wrestling is frequently overlooked in favor of major national promotions, yet it remains the true lifeblood of the industry by keeping the sport closely connected to its local fans. Based on recent coverage of regional events throughout Indiana, these promotions foster genuine, community-driven relationships between performers and audiences without relying on television packages or marketing campaigns. Furthermore, the independent scene is much more than a mere developmental stepping stone, offering deeply personal human stories, lifelong regional careers, and authentic connections that national television cannot replicate.

stories.title: Pro Wrestling EVE to host Will Ospreay's 'Clockwork Carnage' match concept
stories.tldr: Pro Wrestling EVE has announced the debut of Clockwork Carnage, a brand new match type created by AEW World Champion Will Ospreay. The innovative bout will take place during the Global Thunder Queens Attack event on Friday, October 2nd, streaming live on MyAEW PPV and YouTube. Qualifying matches begin on September 4th, with the ultimate winner earning a number one contendership for an EVE Championship of their choice.

stories.title: Wrestling Observer Flashback: Looking back at the first WCW Nitro in 1995
stories.tldr: September 4, 1995 marked the historic debut of WCW Nitro at the Mall of America, launching a show that would famously defeat WWF Raw in the ratings for over eighty weeks. In his original review, Dave Meltzer praised the strong crowd enthusiasm and successful initial impact while heavily criticizing the unprepared three-man commentary team, particularly Steve McMichael. Meltzer also warned against rushed matches, giving away major bouts for free right before a pay-per-view, and relying on non-finishes like the Sting-Flair match.

stories.title: Four-way elimination tag match added to AAA Triplemania 34 Las Vegas
stories.tldr: Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide has added a high-stakes four-way elimination tag team match to the upcoming TripleMania 34 card in Las Vegas. The bout will feature the Latino World Order, Los Americanos, Tokyo Bad Boys, and Fraxiom clashing on September 11. Additionally, Nathan Frazer has secured a spot in a four-way cruiserweight title match on night two in Mexico City.

stories.title: Matt Hardy provides update on Jeff Hardy's expected TNA Wrestling return
stories.tldr: Following the chaotic brawl and upcoming No Disqualification title match between Matt Hardy and TNA World Champion Nic Nemeth, new details have emerged regarding Jeff Hardy's status. Matt Hardy has revealed that his brother is expected to return to television in approximately three weeks around the time TNA tapes in San Antonio, Texas. Matt also admitted that the ambulance angle was partly designed to write Jeff off due to Canadian travel difficulties. Both brothers are currently advertised for the upcoming September tapings.

stories.title: CMLL issues statement regarding Tessa Blanchard's status in MLW
stories.tldr: CMLL has clarified that Tessa Blanchard's upcoming Major League Wrestling debut is currently a one-off appearance rather than a full-time signing. Despite MLW announcing her arrival and Blanchard stating her intention to lead the women's division, her parent promotion CMLL released a statement emphasizing no further dates or championship matches are booked. Blanchard remains under contract with CMLL as her primary home promotion after choosing them over TNA earlier this year.

stories.title: Daily wrestling update covering PWG anniversary, Korakuen Hall, and AEW All Out
stories.tldr: Iconic wrestling venue Korakuen Hall has announced upcoming renovations starting in January that will temporarily close the historic arena until May. In addition, recent WWE NXT budget cuts have begun with the release of Jasper Troy. Meanwhile, extensive post-weekend analysis continues across the industry following major events from AEW and CMLL.

stories.title: Interview with EMERGE Wrestling ring announcer Roger Pettet
stories.tldr: EMERGE Wrestling ring announcer Roger Pettet recently reflected on his unexpected path in the professional wrestling industry. He detailed his transition from a lifelong fan and ring crew volunteer to stepping behind the microphone by accident. Pettet also discussed balancing his career with strict family priorities and his strong belief in the quality of the Indiana independent wrestling scene.

stories.title: Top 10 pro wrestling matches on September 4 in history
stories.tldr: A newly published historical ranking highlights the top ten pro wrestling matches that took place on September 4. The list features bouts from promotions like Pro Wrestling Guerrilla, All Elite Wrestling, and World Wrestling Entertainment. Leading the ratings is a 2009 clash between Bryan Danielson and Chris Hero, followed closely by various international and modern classics. Detailed analysis of the 2022 AEW Trios Championship finals between The Elite and the Dark Order adds further historical depth to the lineup.

stories.title: Title changes on September 4 in wrestling history
stories.tldr: Historical archives highlight notable professional wrestling championship changes that occurred on September 4th throughout the years. Major milestones include Giant Baba claiming the NWA World Heavyweight Title in 1980 and Eddie Guerrero capturing the WWF Intercontinental Championship in 2000. Later historical dates feature CM Punk winning the ECW Championship in 2007 and Bron Breakker securing the NXT United Kingdom Title in 2022.

stories.title: Bryan & Vinny and WOL review AEW Dynamite post-All In and NXT booking
stories.tldr: Wrestling Observer programs recently reviewed the post-All In episode of AEW Dynamite, highlighting a surprisingly strong show that successfully built anticipation for the upcoming All Out pay-per-view. Meanwhile, critics expressed frustration over what they described as preposterous and goddamn stupid booking on NXT, despite acknowledging that the brand still featured a few good matches and strong individual performances from the talent. Coverage also included weekend previews for TNA Impact, WWE SmackDown, and WWE Collision, alongside detailed subscriber reports breaking down the weekly action.

stories.title: AEW and NJPW stars to challenge for CMLL titles at 93rd Aniversario
stories.tldr: CMLL has stacked the card for its upcoming 93rd Aniversario event at Arena Mexico on Friday, September 18, adding two major championship bouts featuring top stars from AEW, NJPW, and Stardom. In the heavyweight division, champion Hechicero will defend his title in a three-way match against AEW's Claudio Castagnoli and NJPW's Zack Sabre Jr. Meanwhile, the women's world title will be on the line in a four-way bout as Persephone defends against Tessa Blanchard, AEW's Mina Shirakawa, and Starlight Kid from Stardom. These high-profile additions join an already star-studded lineup that includes major singles matches and a high-stakes mask versus hair elimination final.

stories.title: AEW secures new Middle East and North Africa TV broadcasting deal
stories.tldr: All Elite Wrestling has secured a new television broadcasting deal to expand its reach into the Middle East and North Africa region. Through a partnership with the streaming platform TOD by beIN, fans will receive access to weekly episodes of Dynamite and Collision, as well as major live pay-per-view events. The new programming lineup will officially be in place in time for this month's All Out event. Financial terms of the agreement and details regarding commentary language options were not disclosed.

stories.title: Jim Ross discusses injury recovery and planned return to AEW commentary
stories.tldr: Wrestling Hall of Famer Jim Ross is targeting an AEW commentary return at the All Out pay-per-view on September 26. Ross recently underwent brain surgery on August 12 and was forced to miss AEW All In in London due to travel risks. Compounding his recovery, he also suffered broken toes on his left foot the morning of his surgery, requiring a walking boot that affects his balance. Despite these hurdles and a recent contract expiration window, he remains optimistic about making the short flight from Oklahoma City to Chicago if his mobility continues to improve.

stories.title: NJPW commentator making AEW TV debut
stories.tldr: New Japan Pro Wrestling and Stardom English-language commentator Walker Stewart is set to make his official All Elite Wrestling television debut on an upcoming episode of Collision. Stewart previously worked on the commentary team for the AEW and NJPW Forbidden Door event, bringing his extensive knowledge of the Japanese wrestling scene to the broadcast. Although he was spotted working the desk during recent tapings for the September 5 show, it remains unconfirmed if this will be a permanent role or a one-night appearance. This addition comes as the promotion continues its ongoing build toward the upcoming All Out pay-per-view event.

stories.title: Dustin Rhodes personal pizza war comments
stories.tldr: AEW veteran Dustin Rhodes has ignited a passionate online debate by declaring New York pizza to be trash and stating that New Haven Tavern style is the superior choice. His latest comments came after fellow wrestler John Silver sparked a discussion by claiming good pizza does not need toppings at all. Rhodes has a history of fiery food takes, having previously condemned supreme pizzas, black olives, pickles, and pineapple.

stories.title: AEW All In 2027 reported to leave Wembley Stadium
stories.tldr: AEW All In is reportedly expected to leave Wembley Stadium in 2027 for a return to North America, according to early backstage indications. While the London venue would take a one-year break, sources emphasize that nothing has been finalized and no specific city or venue has been chosen yet. The news follows All In 2026 at Wembley, which drew strong attendance and a gate approaching six million dollars.

stories.title: Early betting odds released for AEW All Out 2026
stories.tldr: The first betting odds for the upcoming AEW All Out event in Chicago point toward a massive world title defense and a potential tag team championship change. Will Ospreay opens as an astronomical favorite to retain his newly won AEW World Championship against Jon Moxley. Meanwhile, the tag team division is gearing up for an unpredictable three-way ladder match between current champions Christian Cage and Adam Copeland, The Young Bucks, and FTR. Fans will find out if these early lines hold true when the pay-per-view broadcasts live from the NOW Arena on September 26, 2026.

stories.title: AEW All Out 2026 ticket sales update
stories.tldr: AEW All Out 2026 has distributed 7,131 tickets for its September 26 event at the NOW Arena in Hoffman Estates, Illinois, marking an increase of 203 tickets over the span of four days. The show faces direct same-state competition as WWE holds a Worlds Collide event at the Allstate Arena in Rosemont on the exact same night. Meanwhile, two major matches have been officially confirmed for the pay-per-view following this week's television broadcast. Will Ospreay will defend the AEW World Championship against Jon Moxley, and Adam Copeland and Christian Cage will defend the AEW World Tag Team titles in a three-way Tables, Ladders, and Chairs match against FTR and The Young Bucks.

stories.title: Kay Lee Ray returns on MyAEW PPV
stories.tldr: Former WWE performer Kay Lee Ray, also known as Alba Fyre, is set to return for another MyAEW pay-per-view event this Friday. She will face UK standout Safire Reed at Pro Wrestling EVE's Mean Grrrls event in London, England. This follows EVE's first-ever MyAEW pay-per-view, where Ray wrestled a 26-minute main event classic against Miyu Yamashita. Fans can watch this upcoming event either as a one-off purchase on the streaming platform or through the EVE Champion Tier on YouTube.

stories.title: Wrestling Observer Radio covers post-All In Dynamite and international shows
stories.tldr: The latest episode of Wrestling Observer Radio features hosts Bryan Alvarez and Dave Meltzer breaking down a busy week in professional wrestling. The duo covers the fallout from the post-All In episode of AEW Dynamite, matches set for All Out, and Collision spoilers. Additionally, the show dives into WWE Crown Jewel top matches, Kofi Kingston and Austin Creed's appearance with Ariel Helwani, and the upcoming CMLL Anniversary Show card.

stories.title: Ric Flair and Eric Bischoff debate Kenny Omega vs. Will Ospreay match
stories.tldr: Ric Flair is pushing back against the backlash over his recent comments comparing Kenny Omega and Will Ospreay to his classic rivalry with Ricky Steamboat. The Nature Boy clarified that he actually thoroughly enjoyed the match and respects both wrestlers personally. However, Flair lashed out at Eric Bischoff and Jim Ross, demanding that he not be grouped with Bischoff's harsher criticism while warning Ross that mentioning his name will always draw a response.

stories.title: New Level (Kofi Kingston & Xavier Woods) speak on WWE departure, pay cuts, Big E, and AEW debut
stories.tldr: Following their AEW debut as New Level, Kofi Kingston and Austin Creed have shared fresh details regarding the origins of their team name and entrance music, which required assistance from Peter Rosenberg and Big E. The duo also opened up about having no bitterness toward WWE, though Creed was deeply affected by maintaining kayfabe with his family around Big E. Additionally, Swerve Strickland noted he cannot replace Big E in the faction, while Kofi revealed how Prince Nana once influenced his early career.

stories.title: Will Ospreay reflects on AEW All In entrance and match fallout
stories.tldr: Following his emotional title win, Will Ospreay detailed the surreal experience of walking past former rivals and mentors during his entrance. While a future rematch with Kenny Omega remains possible if Omega wants it, Ospreay's immediate first challenger has been revealed as Jon Moxley. Meanwhile, Casino Gauntlet winner Andrade El Idolo is delaying his title shot to focus on defending the National Championship.

stories.title: AEW teases Steven Borden TV debut following Dynamite events
stories.tldr: Following Josh Alexander's shocking return and attack on Steven Borden on Dynamite, attention has turned toward how AEW will book Borden's upcoming television debut. Analysts suggest a tag team match pitting Borden and Darby Allin against Alexander and Mark Davis at All Out is the likely destination for the pay-per-view. Before then, AEW has several weeks of television to build momentum with potential tune-up matches against Don Callis Family associates or other roster members.

stories.title: Adam Copeland set for Maple Leaf Pro debut match
stories.tldr: Steve Maclin has officially accepted Adam Copeland's challenge on MLP Mayhem, confirming their singles match for Maple Leaf Pro Wrestling's Northern Rising event on October 3. The clash at the historic Mattamy Athletic Centre in Toronto adds to a busy autumn schedule for Copeland, who is also booked for an AEW Tag Team title ladder match at All Out just one week prior. Maclin enters the matchup as a free agent following his departure from TNA Wrestling earlier this year.

stories.title: Becky Lynch discusses her WWE career, original title plans, and Nia Jax incident
stories.tldr: During a recent podcast appearance, Becky Lynch reflected on various milestones and hardships throughout her WWE career. She revealed that she was never WWE's original choice to become the inaugural SmackDown Women's Champion, a spot meant for Nikki Bella before fan chants changed plans. Lynch also discussed how Nia Jax breaking her nose in 2018 ultimately altered her career trajectory for the better, leading to her historic WrestleMania main event. Additionally, she shared advice for younger talent, expressed regret over some harsh words spoken during her breakout run, and recalled her early fears of being fired and receiving her ring name.

stories.title: Chelsea Green discusses WWE injury, Twitter exit, pitches, and Hollywood future
stories.tldr: WWE Women's Champion Chelsea Green recently discussed her recovery from a broken orbital bone, explaining her proactive approach to getting medical clearance and returning to the ring. She also detailed why she permanently left Twitter to protect her mental health and backstage workplace relationships from toxic online dogpiling. Furthermore, Green revealed a bold WrestleMania pitch to face Nikki Bella in a hair vs. hair match and shared her ambitions of building an acting career in the horror genre.

stories.title: WWE planning live music concerts and halftime performances for major shows
stories.tldr: WWE is reportedly testing the waters for incorporating live musical performances and halftime-style shows into its major events, beginning with the upcoming Sunday Night's Main Event in Atlanta. TKO views this as a long-term vision to enhance the live fan experience by adding standalone musical attractions when the venue and atmosphere align. Initially, local rapper Lil Yachty was slated to host a live concert at the event, but those plans shifted when he was instead booked for a match against Baron Corbin. Consequently, fellow Atlanta native Quavo was brought in to open the show with a performance of unreleased music.

stories.title: Oba Femi reflects on Brock Lesnar's SummerSlam endorsement and WWE character psychology
stories.tldr: Following his high-profile Hell in a Cell victory over Brock Lesnar in the main event of SummerSlam Night 1, Oba Femi was completely caught off guard when Lesnar returned to the ring to give him an unprecedented, off-script endorsement as the next big thing in WWE. Femi noted that even the camera crew and production staff were shocked by the gesture, which marked a stark departure from Lesnar's typical character during his 25-year career and preceded Lesnar's retirement. In addition to reflecting on the historic moment, Femi discussed his wrestling philosophy and his disdain for characters who appear completely invincible without any human weaknesses. Looking ahead, Femi is now set to square off against Bron Breakker in a massive clash at WWE Sunday Night's Main Event.

stories.title: Backstage frustration in WWE over Netflix Raw censorship restrictions
stories.tldr: WWE post-production staff reportedly feel handcuffed by intensive censorship restrictions imposed by Netflix on Monday Night Raw. The frustration came to a head following a taped episode featuring a brutal parking lot attack by Royce Keys and OTM on The Usos, where blood was heavily pixelated and blurred. While WWE knew parameters would exist in the partnership, the extent of the editing caught some internally off guard, leading executives like Paul Triple H Levesque and talent to unanimously share the unedited footage on social media. This friction highlights a growing tension between WWE creative plans and Netflix international broadcast standards, following previous edits like the removal of a suggestive line by Becky Lynch from an on-demand replay.

stories.title: Jey Uso and Jimmy Uso respond to online criticism and Andrade comments
stories.tldr: The Usos recently sparked social media speculation by posting a blunt message telling critics to stop complaining and asserting that their ability to draw is the main difference between them and others. This followed a recent interview where AEW star Andrade criticized WWE for favoring Samoan wrestlers over Mexican talent. Concurrently, Jey Uso took to Instagram to call out his own online haters, pointing out that none of these critics ever confront him face-to-face in real life.

stories.title: Tony D'Angelo main roster update following NXT Championship loss
stories.tldr: Following his NXT Championship loss to Grayson Waller at Heatwave, Tony D'Angelo is not currently scheduled for a main roster call-up to Raw or SmackDown. Reports indicate that his title loss is not an indictment of how WWE views him, and he will remain a key fixture of the NXT brand in Orlando. Meanwhile, Waller was quickly positioned as the new face of NXT and top heel after transitioning back to the developmental brand from the main roster. D'Angelo is already booked for a six-man tag team match on the upcoming September 8 episode of NXT.

stories.title: WWE Women's Tag Team Division updates and team formations
stories.tldr: With Fatal Influence holding the WWE Women's Tag Team Championships without enough contenders, analysts have proposed several potential new women's alliances including Bayley and AJ Lee, IYO SKY and Sol Ruca, and Giulia and Stephanie Vaquer. Additional roster updates highlight potential team formations for Ivy Nile and Jordynne Grace, as well as Alexa Bliss and Tatum Paxley. Beyond the women's division, the company could also look to reunite established duos like Trick Williams and Carmelo Hayes, or bring Enzo Amore back alongside Big Cass.

stories.title: Jinder Mahal calls Penta vs. Rey Fenix match a missed opportunity for WWE
stories.tldr: Former WWE champion Jinder Mahal recently expressed his view that WWE missed a significant booking opportunity by having Penta defeat his brother Rey Fenix in the finals of a tournament to challenge Roman Reigns. During an appearance on Busted Open, Mahal explained that while Penta was the logical choice for the upcoming World Heavyweight Championship match in Mexico City, Fenix stood to gain much more from the spotlight. Although co-host Bully Ray suggested Fenix lost because management lacked immediate plans for him, Mahal argued that a high-profile performance against Reigns could have elevated Fenix's career trajectory permanently.

stories.title: Blake Monroe scheduled for WWE SmackDown debut
stories.tldr: Blake Monroe is finally set to make her rescheduled in-ring debut on this Friday's episode of WWE SmackDown against Giulia, reviving a rivalry that began years ago in Stardom. The match was originally supposed to happen last month in Toronto, but was called off after Monroe brutally attacked Giulia before the opening bell. The taped broadcast will also feature Sami Zayn addressing his recent interference in a number one contender's match, alongside appearances from Cody Rhodes and Randy Orton ahead of Sunday Night's Main Event.

stories.title: Booker T praises NXT talent including Vanity Project and Kelani Jordan
stories.tldr: Following WWE NXT Heatwave 2026, Hall of Famer and commentator Booker T used his podcast to praise several standout performers on the brand. He highlighted the stable Vanity Project, pointing out Myka Lockwood's immense star potential and comparing her stablemates to a modern-day Midnight Express. Additionally, Booker T celebrated Kelani Jordan capturing her first NXT Women's Championship by defeating Kendal Grey. He expressed confidence in Jordan's ability to carry the division, while offering constructive advice on developing her in-ring instincts as champion.

stories.title: Mr. T criticizes his Netflix documentary
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Mr. T is openly criticizing his own Netflix documentary, Untold Mr. T: I Pity the Fool, calling the project garbage and stating that it completely missed the mark on who he is. He argues that director Scott Weintrob pushed a hidden agenda by focusing entirely on his tough-guy persona while ignoring his faith, charity work, and family values. Furthermore, Mr. T took issue with the documentary downplaying his career choices, omitting his pastor, and including an agent he explicitly asked to be left out.

stories.title: Chelsea Green considers surrogacy with Matt Cardona
stories.tldr: WWE star Chelsea Green has revealed that she and her husband, Matt Cardona, are ready to start a family together. During a recent interview, Green shared that she is having open and honest conversations with WWE management about potentially taking time away in the future. While she is still figuring out the exact path to parenthood, she noted that surrogacy is one of the options she is considering. Green also humorously warned that Cardona will need to secure his famous action figure collection once they have children.

stories.title: Summer Rae sparks WWE in-ring return rumors
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Summer Rae has sparked speculation about an in-ring return after sharing Instagram Stories of herself wearing wrestling gear and adjusting her boots. The posts conveniently arrived just hours after Carmella seemingly confirmed her own retirement, amplifying fan discussions about past talent. Rae last competed in the 2022 Women's Royal Rumble and has previously expressed a strong desire to work with WWE again despite battling past back injuries. While no official comeback has been announced, her recent social media activity has fans wondering if she is preparing for another run.

stories.title: Tatum Paxley plays Mario theme on flute on Instagram
stories.tldr: WWE SmackDown Superstar Tatum Paxley surprised fans on Instagram by posting a random video of herself playing the Super Mario theme on a flute. With the simple two-word caption Game over, the clip offered a bizarre and unexpected look at her hidden musical talents. While Paxley is already known for her unpredictable television persona, this quirky performance was certainly not on anyone's wrestling bingo card for the day.

stories.title: WWE considering re-casting classic gimmick characters
stories.tldr: WWE is reportedly exploring the possibility of bringing back classic 1980s and 1990s wrestling gimmicks with modern twists by re-casting them for a new era. Rather than direct carbon copies, these reimagined characters could feature contemporary updates tailored for today's programming and digital spaces. The list of potential character revivals includes nostalgic personas like The Repo Man, The Ultimate Warrior, The Undertaker, Tiger Jackson, and The Million Dollar Man. This creative direction opens up fun new possibilities for modern storylines and rising talent across the roster.

stories.title: WWE WarGames format changes considered for Survivor Series
stories.tldr: WWE is reportedly considering a major format change for the traditional WarGames matches at the upcoming Survivor Series event, moving away from the standard two-team structure. Recent storylines on Raw involving The Bloodline, Solo Sikoa, LA Knight, and the debuting trio known as 946 hint at a potential three-way match featuring teams of three. This would echo the unique three-way WarGames format first introduced back at NXT TakeOver in 2017. Speculation is already swirling regarding potential third-man partners like Jacob Fatu, Seth Rollins, Penta, or Drew McIntyre to round out the competing factions.

stories.title: Speculation builds over WWE 2K27 cover star
stories.tldr: Speculation is already building regarding who will grace the cover of the upcoming WWE 2K27 video game early next year. Following recent cover stars like CM Punk, Roman Reigns, and Cody Rhodes, the company is expected to pick someone fresh for the front of the box. Potential candidates include breakout star Oba Femi, nostalgia pick Brock Lesnar, and top womens division star Rhea Ripley.

stories.title: CM Punk films role for ABC series
stories.tldr: Undisputed WWE Champion CM Punk has expanded his acting resume by reportedly filming a guest role for the upcoming season of the ABC series RJ Decker. Reports indicate that Punk recently shot his episode on location in Florida, though specific details regarding his character are currently being kept under wraps. This new television gig follows a busy period of outside projects for Punk, including voice acting in Zootopia 2 and appearances on various network and streaming shows.

stories.title: TKO strategy and long-term vision for WWE Premium Live Events
stories.tldr: TKO is implementing a new long-term vision for WWE premium live events that focuses heavily on commercial growth, celebrity involvement, and mainstream entertainment elements like live musical performances modeled after Super Bowl halftime shows. While this business-first strategy is generating record revenue and aiming to attract lapsed fans through spectacles such as Lil Yachty stepping into the ring and Quavo performing live, it has also resulted in fewer matches and a reduced emphasis on the in-ring wrestling product. Consequently, long-time fans are experiencing a dip in enthusiasm as the company shifts away from traditional storytelling and pure wrestling towards high-profile pop culture crossovers and increased ad integration.

stories.title: Bayley signs new WWE contract and return plans in motion
stories.tldr: Bayley is reportedly expected to stay with WWE after agreeing to a new contract extension that may eventually include backstage responsibilities beyond her on-screen role. Backstage creative plans are currently in motion for her return to the Raw brand, with her comeback anticipated within the next few weeks. This update largely puts to rest recent speculation regarding a potential departure to AEW.

stories.title: Ridge Holland and New Day/New Level WWE pay cut controversy
stories.tldr: Following recent on-screen jabs about WWE lowering talent salaries, the pay cut controversy has continued to grow with new revelations from former roster members. Former WWE star Ridge Holland revealed he faced his own 56 percent pay cut during contract talks prior to his departure. Meanwhile, conflicting backstage rumors suggested The New Day's proposed reduction could have reached 75 percent, though insiders clarified it was closer to the slightly-over-50-percent mark the wrestlers themselves acknowledged.

stories.title: Grayson Waller wins NXT Championship and reacts to title contenders and TNA locker room
stories.tldr: Following his NXT Championship victory, Grayson Waller is already facing a crowded field of challengers looking to dethrone him. Backstage reports indicate his title win was planned weeks in advance, while former champion Tony D'Angelo will remain on the brand without an immediate main roster call-up. To sort through the contenders, NXT has booked a series of matches to determine the official number one contender, prompting Waller to publicly dismiss most of his new rivals while offering rare praise for a select few.

stories.title: Bronson Reed set for major heel return on WWE TV
stories.tldr: Creative plans are now locked in for Bronson Reed, whose imminent return to WWE television has gained significant momentum. During a recent visit to company headquarters in Stamford, Connecticut, Reed filmed promotional material and collaborated on new merchandise concepts. While an exact return date remains unconfirmed, speculation has grown that he could make his presence felt as soon as this weekend's Sunday Night Main Event.

stories.title: WWE NXT previews high-stakes trios match
stories.tldr: Following recent roster tension, NXT General Manager Robert Stone has officially booked a high-stakes trios match for this Tuesday's episode. Tony D'Angelo, Mason Rook, and Saquon Shugars will face EK Prosper, Cruz Montana, and Keanu Carver. The three members of the winning team will advance to a triple threat match on September 15, where the winner earns a shot at NXT Champion Grayson Waller.

stories.title: Ticket sales update for WWE Sunday Night's Main Event
stories.tldr: As Sunday Night's Main Event approaches in Atlanta, ticket sales have reached 9,177 distributed seats with about 144 resale tickets still available. WrestleTix reports an increase of 860 tickets since the previous count, though the event has not yet reached the venue's recent Raw attendance or the 2026 year-to-date average. WWE has also finalized the match card and released global start times for fans tuning in around the world.

stories.title: Planned return teased for WWE Sunday Night's Main Event
stories.tldr: Bronson Reed is reportedly cleared and expected to return as soon as Sunday Night's Main Event in Atlanta. Having been out since February with a torn bicep, Reed could directly impact the high-stakes match between Bron Breakker and Oba Femi. Creative options for his return range from reuniting with his Vision stablemate Breakker to targeting the group for going soft.

stories.title: Matt Hardy and Nic Nemeth set for No DQ TNA World Title fight on TNA Impact
stories.tldr: TNA has announced a massive No Disqualification match between TNA World Champion Nic Nemeth and Matt Hardy for next week's TNA Impact following a chaotic backstage brawl. The intense rivalry stems from mutual accusations over mysterious backstage attacks on Jeff Hardy and Ryan Nemeth following Lockdown. Additionally, the upcoming card will feature Xia Brookside defending the Knockouts World Championship against Gabby Forza and an X-Division Championship qualifier between Fabian Aichner and Rohit Raju.

stories.title: KC Navarro qualifies for TNA X Division Championship match at Bound for Glory
stories.tldr: KC Navarro has punched his ticket to TNA Bound for Glory by defeating Joe Alonzo on TNA Impact to become the first competitor to qualify for the vacant X Division Championship match. The title was left vacant after recent champion Leon Slater chose to exercise Option C, relinquishing the X Division belt to challenge Nic Nemeth for the TNA World Championship. TNA has since announced that a six-way scramble match will take place at the October 11 event in Tampa, Florida, to crown the new champion, leaving five spots remaining to be filled.

stories.title: Daily Wrestling Updates and Top Matches in History
stories.tldr: Recent wrestling updates feature The Usos responding to Andrade El Idolo regarding roster opportunities, Dave Bautista training to play Kratos in an upcoming Amazon series, and Stephanie Vaquer reflecting on returning to perform in the same Chilean arena she first visited as a fan seventeen years ago. Historical retrospectives highlight iconic September 3 matches, including Gunther versus Sheamus at Clash at the Castle 2022 and Bryan Danielson versus Ricky Starks at All Out 2023. Additionally, archival data details notable historical title changes that occurred on September 3 across various promotions.

stories.title: Roxanne Perez and Nattie added to AAA Triplemania 34 match
stories.tldr: AAA has added a high-stakes four-way match featuring WWE stars Roxanne Perez and Natalya alongside Faby Apache and La Hiedra to the TripleMania 34 card in Las Vegas on September 11, 2026. The winner of this bout will earn a shot at the AAA Reina de Reinas Championship at the upcoming WWE Worlds Collide event in Chicago. This major addition helps flesh out the Las Vegas portion of the weekend, as reigning champion Lady Flammer is separately set to defend her title against La Catalina in Mexico City.

stories.title: Allie & Kiera Hogan retain Knockouts Tag Team Titles in TNA Impact open challenge
stories.tldr: TNA Knockouts Tag Team Champions Allie and Kiera Hogan successfully defended their titles in an open challenge against indie standouts Shazza McKenzie and Vipress on the latest episode of TNA Impact in Brampton. Allie secured the victory by pinning Vipress following a combined codebreaker and Face The Music maneuver. Allie is currently defending the titles alongside Hogan due to her original partner Rosemary being sidelined with a significant injury.

stories.title: Tate Mayfairs involved in car accident after falling asleep at wheel
stories.tldr: Independent wrestler Tate Mayfairs miraculously survived a severe car accident after falling asleep at the wheel and crashing his BMW into bollards on the opposite side of the road. Despite totaling his vehicle, Mayfairs walked away completely uninjured and quickly clarified that the terrifying incident was a real-life emergency rather than a wrestling storyline. He used the close call to issue a stern warning to fellow performers about the hazards of fatigue, urging them to utilize provided hotels and rest instead of pushing through dangerous late-night drives.

stories.title: Shota Umino diagnosed with concussion and amnesia after NJPW G1 Climax 36
stories.tldr: New Japan Pro Wrestling star Shota Umino has revealed he suffered a severe concussion and amnesia following his match against Zack Sabre Jr on the opening night of the G1 Climax 36 tournament on July 11. The accumulated damage led to frightening symptoms including memory loss of how he returned to his hotel and midnight vomiting episodes that forced him to miss the entire tournament. Fortunately, Umino has been cleared to make his in-ring return at NJPW Road to Destruction, where he aims to claw his way back to the top and eventually challenge IWGP Global Heavyweight Champion Gabe Kidd.

stories.title: Juggalo Championship Wrestling announces championship matches for Lunacy 100th episode
stories.tldr: Juggalo Championship Wrestling is celebrating the 100th episode of Lunacy with a free special event titled Carnival of Chaos on September 24, 2026, at the Grindhouse Arena in Jeffersonville, Indiana. To mark the milestone, management has officially announced two major championship matches for the card. Women World Champion Dani Mo will defend her title against Alice Crowley, and Josh Bishop will put the Linear World Championship on the line in a triple threat match against Krule and Cokane.

stories.title: TNA Wrestling signs three new talent
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling is experiencing significant roster changes in 2026, highlighted by the recent arrival of former WWE star Zoey Serrano ahead of Bound for Glory. To bolster its main event scene, the company is viewed as a prime destination for several high-profile free agents. Speculation surrounds potential arrivals including Romeo Malverde, the tandem of Killer Kross and Scarlett Bordeaux, and the husband-and-wife duo of Malakai Black and Xelina.

stories.title: Sonya Deville (Daria Rae) lands role in Netflix series
stories.tldr: TNA Director of Operations Daria Rae, formerly known in WWE as Sonya Deville, has reportedly landed an acting role in an upcoming Netflix television series called Myron Bolitar. Rae is set to portray a professional wrestler named Fury, with production currently underway in New York. Alongside her new television venture, she continues her on-screen authority role with TNA Wrestling following her recent contract renewal.

stories.title: Zoey Serrano loses first match in TNA and reflects on NXT preparing wrestlers
stories.tldr: Following her recent TNA debut and name change, Zoey Serrano suffered her first defeat in the promotion due to miscommunication with her tag team partner. The loss unfolded when Serrano accidentally struck Xia Brookside, allowing Indi Hartwell and Harley Hudson to capitalize. Outside of the ring, Serrano also spoke candidly about her time in WWE, arguing that NXT does not properly prepare wrestlers for the pressures of the main roster.

stories.title: Eric Bischoff discusses WCW nWo booking and Ted DiBiase casting
stories.tldr: Eric Bischoff has updated his thoughts on Ted DiBiase joining the early New World Order, admitting that despite looking like a perfect spokesperson on paper, the casting ultimately did not work out. Bischoff explained that the lingering WWF Million Dollar Man persona conflicted with the grounded, reality-based vibe the nWo needed, leading him to label the move as bad casting due to a lack of chemistry. In addition to reflecting on DiBiase, Bischoff discussed the booking strategy behind smaller subversive acts during the 1996 angle, such as spray-painting the WCW production truck.

stories.title: Will Ospreay to defend AEW World Championship against Jon Moxley at All Out 2026
stories.tldr: Fresh off his AEW World Championship victory over Kenny Omega at All In: London, Will Ospreay has learned that his first title defense will be against Jon Moxley at All Out on September 26 in Chicago. The blockbuster match was surprisingly booked and revealed on the September 2 episode of Dynamite following a chaotic segment where Moxley saved Ospreay from an attack by Gabe Kidd. Additionally, the All Out card will feature a three-way TLC match for the AEW World Tag Team Championships involving champions Adam Copeland and Christian Cage, FTR, and The Young Bucks.

stories.title: Adam Copeland & Christian Cage challenge Young Bucks and FTR to TLC match at All Out
stories.tldr: Following a controversial title defense using a hidden wrench against The Young Bucks at AEW All In, World Tag Team Champions Adam Copeland and Christian Cage faced challenges from both the Bucks and a returning FTR on the September 2 episode of Dynamite. To settle the mounting tensions, Copeland proposed a chaotic three-way match for AEW All Out on September 26. The bout has officially been set as a high-stakes encounter where tables, ladders, and chairs will all be legal.

stories.title: Josh Alexander returns from injury on AEW Dynamite and attacks Steven Borden
stories.tldr: Josh Alexander made a surprising return on the September 2 episode of AEW Dynamite after being sidelined since March with a severe knee injury. Aligning with the Don Callis Family, Alexander blindsided Steven Borden, who had run out to save TNT Champion Darby Allin from a post-match beatdown. Alexander then locked Allin in an ankle lock while Mark Davis hit Borden with a piledriver. This explosive comeback positions Alexander as a top challenger to Allin's championship reign.

stories.title: Ric Flair responds to comparisons between Omega vs. Ospreay and Steamboat rivalry
stories.tldr: Following Will Ospreay and Kenny Omega's acclaimed match at AEW All In: London, some fans and journalists compared their rivalry to Ric Flair and Ricky Steamboat's legendary series. Country music star Darius Rucker initially sparked the debate by arguing modern wrestling cannot replicate the territory era. Ric Flair then weighed in on social media, praising Omega and Ospreay as talented youth but firmly dismissing the comparisons. Flair argued that modern stars must match the grueling schedule and decades-long legacy of his historic matches with Steamboat before earning such praise.

stories.title: Athena aims for Hulk Hogan's title reign record and AEW Women's World Championship
stories.tldr: Ring of Honor Women's World Champion Athena is celebrating a historic, nearly four-year title reign while setting her sights on massive new milestones. She aims to surpass Hulk Hogan's 1,474-day WWF World Heavyweight Championship reign by Christmas. Furthermore, Athena has expressed a strong desire to transition to a full-time role in AEW and capture every available women's title, including the AEW Women's World Championship, the TBS Championship, and the tag team titles.

stories.title: Christian Cage mocks WWE talent over reported 50% pay cuts
stories.tldr: During a heated promo segment on AEW Dynamite, Christian Cage took a direct jab at WWE and TKO management by mocking recent reports of talent facing 50 percent pay cuts. Cage used the real-world controversy to insult the Young Bucks and FTR, questioning why they wouldn't be embarrassed enough to take a massive pay cut and jump to another promotion. This real-world heat intertwined with an ongoing storyline setting up a massive three-way ladder match for the AEW World Tag Team Championship at All Out.

stories.title: Maya World discusses WNBA dreams and calls out Britt Baker
stories.tldr: Former AEW TBS Champion Maya World recently reflected on her childhood dreams of playing in the WNBA before transitioning to professional wrestling. Shortly after losing her title to Persephone at All In 2026 due to interference from a masked, returning Britt Baker, World made a high-profile appearance at a Texas Rangers game. During her time at Globe Life Field, World threw out the ceremonial first pitch and promptly called out both Persephone and Baker, demanding a one-on-one rematch and challenging Baker to stop hiding.

stories.title: Darby Allin retains TNT Championship against Mark Davis on Dynamite
stories.tldr: Darby Allin successfully defended his newly won TNT Championship against Mark Davis on AEW Dynamite following a brutal brawl that spanned from the entrance ramp into the crowd. Davis challenged on behalf of the Don Callis Family after Allin captured the gold from Kevin Knight at All In. Despite interference from Don Callis, Allin secured the victory with a pair of Coffin Drops. However, his celebration was cut short when a returning Josh Alexander brutally attacked both Allin and Steve Borden.

stories.title: Will Ospreay kicks off AEW Dynamite following World Title victory
stories.tldr: Following a historic victory at All In in London where he defeated Kenny Omega in the main event, new AEW World Champion Will Ospreay will kick off tonight's fallout episode of Dynamite live from Allen, Texas. Ospreay begins his championship reign with a future challenger already lined up in Andrade El Idolo, who won the Casino Gauntlet match at the pay-per-view. The stacked card on TBS and HBO Max will also feature a championship celebration for new AEW Women's World Champion Mercedes Mone, who defeated Willow Nightingale, alongside a six-man tag team match.

stories.title: Will Ospreay announces plans to form new United Empire faction in AEW
stories.tldr: Fresh off his AEW World Championship victory over Kenny Omega at All In, Will Ospreay opened Dynamite by announcing his plans to establish a new, separate iteration of his famous NJPW faction, the United Empire, inside AEW using new local roster members. During his promo, Ospreay also addressed a potential tiebreaker match with Omega and thanked his stablemates Callum Newman, Francesco Akira, and HENARE for their support. The celebration was quickly cut short by interruptions from longtime rival Ricochet and groups like The Demand and The Dogs, leading to a massive 10-man tag team main event later in the night.

stories.title: AEW Collision Sept 5 lineup announced featuring Motor City Machine Guns
stories.tldr: The upcoming episode of AEW Collision features the promotional in-ring debut of the Motor City Machine Guns against The Swirl. Andrade El Idolo will defend the AEW National Championship against Gabe Kidd in a highly anticipated rematch, while Persephone puts her TBS Championship on the line against Vertvixen. The stacked card, taped in Allen, Texas, also showcases the Young Bucks, Athena, and several other marquee matchups.

stories.title: Thekla crashes Mercedes Moné's AEW Women's World Title celebration
stories.tldr: Following her AEW Women's World Championship victory over Willow Nightingale at All In London, Mercedes Mone hosted a celebration on Dynamite boasting about her accomplishments across four major companies. Her festivities were abruptly interrupted by Thekla, known as the Toxic Spider, who brought tequila and immediately staked her claim to the title. Thekla confronted Mone over stolen catchphrases and her championship-swinging habits, setting the stage for what appears to be Mone's first major championship feud heading toward the upcoming All Out pay-per-view.

stories.title: Wrestling Observer Daily Update highlights and news roundup
stories.tldr: This daily update covers major professional wrestling news, including the integration of ESPN Unlimited into YouTube TV and John Cena reflecting on his empty-arena WrestleMania match against Bray Wyatt. It also details Kofi discussing his transition from WWE to AEW, alongside a deep dive into historical Cagematch ratings for women's wrestling matches following AEW All In. Additionally, various talent updates, media appearances, and personal notes for several industry personalities are highlighted.

stories.title: Nick Jackson reflects on AEW All In 2026 pay-per-view
stories.tldr: Following AEW All In London 2026 at Wembley Stadium, the company has entered a monumental new era featuring major title changes, high-profile debuts, and massive landscape shifts. Will Ospreay captured the AEW World Championship by defeating Kenny Omega, while Mercedes Mone secured the AEW Women's World Championship over Willow Nightingale. In the tag team division, despite losing their match to Adam Copeland and Christian Cage, The Young Bucks' Nick Jackson expressed immense pride after rewatching the event, declaring it the best All In the company has ever produced. The historic pay-per-view also featured stunning debuts like The New Level and the return of Dr. Britt Baker D.M.D.

stories.title: Claudio Castagnoli explains how baseball inspired his WWE tag title win
stories.tldr: AEW star Claudio Castagnoli recently discussed the unique finish to his and Sheamus's 2016 WWE tag team championship victory over The New Day. Speaking on My Mom's Basement with Robbie Fox, Castagnoli revealed that the iconic fake tag spot was inspired by baseball players stealing a base. This clever deception caught Kofi Kingston off guard, allowing Sheamus to secure the roll-up pinfall and end The New Day's historic 483-day title reign.

stories.title: Backstage news on how CMLL views AEW's Claudio Castagnoli
stories.tldr: AEW star Claudio Castagnoli has earned immense respect from CMLL luchadors and management for his exceptional conditioning and stamina in Mexico's high altitude. Unlike many American wrestlers who struggle with the elements at Arena Mexico, Castagnoli performs grueling matches without getting tired. His dedication led to a lengthy CMLL World Heavyweight Championship reign and a grueling 74-minute performance at the CMLL International Gran Prix. This mutual admiration resulted in Castagnoli becoming the first AEW star to sign a dual AEW and CMLL contract earlier this year.

stories.title: BJ Ray comments on Val Venis and MJF height-lift controversy
stories.tldr: Former WWE star BJ Ray has weighed in on an ongoing social media feud by supporting Val Venis's claims about wrestlers using footwear and inserts to artificially increase their height. Venis previously mocked AEW star MJF by posting a photo of his boots and suggesting he uses lifts while still appearing very short, which escalated a prior debate over wrestling styles. While Ray did not confirm that MJF specifically uses lifts, he noted that thick boots and inserts commonly add up to five inches to a performer's stature.

stories.title: Darby Allin discusses close relationship with Sting's son Steven Borden
stories.tldr: Darby Allin recently opened up about his close bond with Steven Borden, the son of wrestling legend Sting, whom Allin personally trained for the business. Steven recently appeared at AEW All In to assist Allin, marking a major milestone in his budding career. Allin expressed a strong desire to pay back everything Sting taught him by guiding Steven and even hinted at a potential future tag team run with him.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite 9/2/2026: 3 Things We Hated & 3 Things We Loved
stories.tldr: The latest episode of AEW Dynamite followed up on the fallout from All In with new world champions, a debut, and championship defenses. Reviewers shared mixed opinions on the night, criticizing Will Ospreay's stagnant faction storyline and Athena's apparent relegation to Collision. However, they heavily praised a fast-paced and innovative AEW World Trios Championship match featuring Swerve Strickland, New Level, and The Rascalz.

stories.title: AEW World Champion Will Ospreay admits he’s not the best in the world, unless he is
stories.tldr: Fresh off his monumental AEW World Championship victory over Kenny Omega at All In 2026, Will Ospreay opened Dynamite with a celebratory promo addressing his massive win. He initially conceded that Omega remains the world's best for most of the year, before boldly declaring himself the new standard and offering Omega a rematch whenever he wants. Ospreay then shifted his focus to bringing the United Empire into AEW, which promptly drew out rivals like Ricochet and Gabe Kidd to set up a massive tag team main event later in the evening.

stories.title: Swerve Strickland and New Level (Kofi & Austin Creed) win AEW World Trios Title defense
stories.tldr: Swerve Strickland and New Level successfully defended their AEW World Trios Championships against The Rascalz on Dynamite before facing a tense post-match staredown from The Young Bucks. In recent interviews, Kofi Kingston and Austin Creed opened up about their WWE departure following proposed pay cuts exceeding fifty percent and a painful kayfabe incident involving Big E. They also revealed they only negotiated with AEW because of its premier tag team division and expressed a decade-long desire to finally face teams like The Elite.

stories.title: Andrade El Idolo explains why he left AEW for WWE and clarifies Samoan comments
stories.tldr: Andrade El Idolo has revealed that his primary motivation for returning to WWE in 2024 was wanting to work with his then-wife Charlotte Flair. He also clarified recent remarks regarding WWE favoring Samoan talent over Mexican stars, emphasizing that he holds no ill will toward wrestlers like Roman Reigns and that they always treated him great. Furthermore, Andrade explained that during his second WWE stint, management wanted him to appear for AAA, but he declined because he had already established himself in Mexico and wanted a global platform.

stories.title: Rumors of potential AEW talent contracts expiring and jumping to WWE
stories.tldr: Alongside Anthony Bowens, Max Caster is also facing a contract expiration on October 1st as potential departures loom for AEW. Industry observers note that several other deals are quietly expiring or shifting, opening the door for possible roster changes. Names like Jim Ross, Kip Sabian, and Tay Melo are also part of the broader conversation surrounding shifting talent landscapes.

stories.title: Backstage update on Ivy Nile's WWE contract status and TV absence
stories.tldr: WWE star Ivy Nile is facing a crucial crossroads as her current contract is set to expire this fall with no official word yet on a new deal. Despite being largely absent from Monday Night Raw since March and primarily competing on Main Event, backstage reports indicate that creative has been developing significant plans and a major character change for her. These ongoing discussions suggest the company maintains an interest in retaining her services and refreshing her presentation moving forward.

stories.title: WWE files new trademark application for 'WWE Vault'
stories.tldr: WWE has submitted a new trademark application to the United States Patent and Trademark Office for the term WWE Vault. This filing follows a previous dispute between 2024 and 2026 where the initial request faced hurdles due to potential confusion with a ticketing company's trademark called The Vault. The Vault branding has grown immensely popular through the company's archival YouTube channel, which currently boasts over 4.29 million subscribers, and has expanded to other platforms like Netflix with the WWE Raw Vault.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown August 28, 2026 viewership ratings
stories.tldr: The August 28, 2026 episode of WWE SmackDown on the USA Network brought in varying viewership reports, with one source citing an astronomical 11.2 million viewers while another industry report noted 1.12 million viewers. The taped episode posted a 0.23 rating in the key 18 to 49 demographic, marking a decline from the previous week's 0.32 demo rating. Alongside the linear television figures, the broadcast generated strong digital engagement with prominent YouTube clips featuring top stars.

stories.title: Grayson Waller comments on main roster WWE run alongside New Day
stories.tldr: Grayson Waller recently reflected on his main roster WWE run and his time working alongside Kofi Kingston and Austin Creed. He explained that management instructed him to adopt a more serious persona, but his pairing with the New Day forced him to wear silly hats and joke around instead. Waller holds immense respect for the tag team, but feels that this comedic creative direction prevented him from proving his serious side. Now back in NXT and holding the NXT Championship, Waller believes he finally has the opportunity to show everyone who he really is.

stories.title: Lexis King addresses WWE retiring Men's Speed Title
stories.tldr: WWE recently retired both the Men's and Women's Speed Championships during an episode of NXT. Lexis King, who held the men's title for 133 days without losing it in the ring, heavily criticized the decision on social media. King claimed management stripped him of the belt because no one in NXT could defeat him and vowed to remain the Fastest Man Alive indefinitely. The retirement concludes the brief lineage of the Speed titles, which originated as a social media partnership before moving exclusively to the NXT brand.

stories.title: Former WWE star CJ 'Lana' Perry releasing spy thriller novel
stories.tldr: Former WWE star CJ Perry, widely known to wrestling fans as Lana, is venturing into the literary world with her upcoming spy thriller novel titled Bulletproof Angel. Co-associated with international bestselling author Blake Northcott, the high-octane book follows a young CIA operative in Russia whose mind becomes a target after she memorizes the code to a devastating superweapon. The novel is officially scheduled for release on November 10, 2026, and is being represented by Paradigm Talent Agency.

stories.title: John Cena discusses Firefly Fun House match and Bray Wyatt WrestleMania bout
stories.tldr: John Cena recently revealed that he genuinely believed his surreal Firefly Fun House match against Bray Wyatt at WrestleMania 36 in 2020 would be the final bout of his career. Speaking about the cinematic encounter, Cena described it as a meta journey of facing his demons and letting go during the empty-arena pandemic era. Although he continued wrestling until his official retirement tour concluded in late 2025, the deeply personal collaboration with the late Bray Wyatt stands out as a major milestone. Cena also opened up about the physical toll of his final years in the ring and how post-retirement training has finally allowed his body to recover.

stories.title: Bron Breakker calls himself top athlete and discusses WWE legacy
stories.tldr: In a recent interview with 11Alive, WWE star Bron Breakker discussed his transition from football to professional wrestling and the legacy he hopes to leave behind. Breakker stated that he wants to be remembered as an absolute dog and arguably the greatest athlete in the company. He also explained that he is a forward-thinking, goal-oriented person who prefers to focus on his future accomplishments rather than reminisce about past moments.

stories.title: John Cena congratulates The Miz on 20th anniversary of WWE debut
stories.tldr: John Cena publicly congratulated The Miz on the 20th anniversary of his WWE in-ring debut, praising his work ethic and noting that he frequently uses Miz as a positive example for younger talent. The Miz marked the milestone by confirming he has no immediate plans to retire and remains active on television and live events. The two veterans share a long history, highlighted by their WrestleMania 27 main event and subsequent career interactions.

stories.title: Kelani Jordan reflects on NXT career challenges
stories.tldr: Newly crowned NXT Women’s Champion Kelani Jordan recently reflected on the most challenging phase of her WWE career during a post-event interview. She admitted that losing the North American Championship and drifting without a clear creative direction left her struggling to define her on-screen character. This transitional period forced her to realize she needed to shed her cheerful persona and develop a much harder competitive edge. Ultimately, this crucial stage of self-reflection paved the way for her recent championship success and necessary professional evolution.

stories.title: Rumor Roundup and backstage wrestling news updates
stories.tldr: Recent wrestling rumors indicate that Ivy Nile's WWE contract is expiring this fall, though creative has significant changes planned if she chooses to re-sign. In other news, a former star confirmed that WWE owns the UpUpDownDown intellectual property, and social media activity suggests that Stephanie Vaquer and Myles Borne have broken up. Additional updates cover Andrade's AEW earnings, a public disagreement between Nick and Brooke Hogan regarding their relationship status, and a bizarre historical locker room story from Jake Roberts about Andre the Giant.

stories.title: Swerve Strickland comments on Bianca Belair's WWE future
stories.tldr: AEW star Swerve Strickland recently shared high praise for absent WWE star Bianca Belair, calling her a living legend who still has plenty to offer the wrestling world. Belair has been out of action for over a year due to a finger injury suffered at WrestleMania 41, followed by her pregnancy announcement at WrestleMania 42 and recently welcoming a baby. Although there is no confirmed timetable for her return, Strickland remains hopeful that she will eventually come back to the ring and elevate the standard of the industry once again.

stories.title: Stephanie Vaquer and Myles Borne rumored to have broken up
stories.tldr: WWE stars Stephanie Vaquer and Myles Borne have sparked rumors of a real-life breakup after fans noticed they unfollowed each other on Instagram. The couple has also seemingly removed all public traces of their relationship, including photos, comments, and previous messages celebrating Borne's championship wins. Although neither wrestler has officially confirmed a split, their sudden social media purge has led to widespread speculation among fans.

stories.title: Nic Nemeth shares thoughts on Paul Heyman potentially managing Oba Femi
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Nic Nemeth recently discussed the potential storyline of Hall of Famer Paul Heyman managing rising star Oba Femi on Busted Open Radio. With Heyman showing respect to both Femi and Bron Breakker ahead of their upcoming clash at Sunday Night's Main Event, Nemeth believes Heyman is either playing the percentages or preparing to align with the next top star. While Nemeth sees multiple creative directions for how a partnership or betrayal could unfold, he ultimately praised Femi for delivering on every opportunity despite being envious of his massive push.

stories.title: WWE backstage figure returning for first match in five years in another promotion
stories.tldr: Former WWE star and current NXT producer Drake Maverick, performing under his pre-WWE name Rockstar Spud, is returning to the wrestling ring for his first match since 2021. He will face long-time rival and former NXT UK star Dave Mastiff at PROGRESS Wrestling's event on September 12 at the Bournemouth O2 Academy. Spud has also been booked for another PROGRESS show on September 13 in Birmingham, though his opponent for that night has not yet been announced.

stories.title: WWE NXT faction member rumored for main roster call up
stories.tldr: During recent NXT events, Bloodline family member Zilla Fatu was confronted by the Birth Right faction after securing his first singles victory. Fatu rejected their recruitment offer after Charlie Dempsey insultingly claimed Fatu would be bottom of the barrel on the main roster compared to his famous relatives. This interaction has sparked heavy speculation that Birth Right itself, featuring second and fourth-generation talents like Lexis King, Charlie Dempsey, Uriah Connors, Arianna Grace, and Channing Stacks Lorenzo, could soon be heading to the main roster.
