stories.title: Grayson Waller reflects on WWE NXT Championship win at Heatwave
stories.tldr: Following his NXT Championship win at Heatwave, Grayson Waller revealed he recently feared an imminent WWE release and believed his career had hit a dead end. Waller explained that Shawn Michaels personally asked him to return to NXT because the brand needed someone to shake up the men's division. Meanwhile, commentator Booker T praised the title change, noting that the crowded main roster makes NXT a crucial platform for talent to stand out.

stories.title: Tommy Dreamer compares Roman Reigns' potential Mexico City reception to John Cena
stories.tldr: Tommy Dreamer believes Roman Reigns could face a heavily hostile crowd when defending his title against Penta in Mexico City. Speaking on Busted Open, Dreamer compared the potential atmosphere to John Cena facing Rob Van Dam at ECW One Night Stand, though he noted that extreme level of heat is rare. He also praised the Raw closing segment where Reigns endorsed Penta, helping cement the challenger's status as a top-tier act.

stories.title: Tyler Breeze clarifies UpUpDownDown ownership and confirms WWE contract end
stories.tldr: Following the expiration of his unique WWE contract, Tyler Breeze has clarified that WWE owns the inactive UpUpDownDown gaming channel. Breeze admitted he regrets staying behind for the YouTube brand in 2021 instead of pursuing AEW at the time. With his previous television restrictions now lifted, the veteran is fully open to joining AEW, TNA, or other promotions.

stories.title: Tommy Dreamer praises Penta vs. Rey Fenix on WWE Raw as match of the year
stories.tldr: Wrestling veteran Tommy Dreamer has heavily praised the recent singles match between brothers Penta and Rey Fenix on WWE Raw. Speaking on Busted Open Radio, Dreamer declared the bout to be the best professional wrestling match of 2026 so far. As a result of his tournament-winning victory, Penta has earned a World Championship match against Roman Reigns. That title bout is officially scheduled for the September 14 edition of Raw in Mexico.

stories.title: Retired WWE Championship To Be Brought Back
stories.tldr: Following the recent retirement of the NXT Speed championships, analysts are arguing that WWE should revive the defunct NXT Women's Tag Team Championship to fix a brand imbalance. The secondary women's titles were originally retired after being unified with the main roster belts, leaving NXT without a dedicated women's tag division. Pundits believe bringing back these championships makes sense given the strength of the NXT women's roster, with potential teams like Wren Sinclair and Kendal Grey or Arianna Grace and Xia Brookside waiting in the wings.

stories.title: Grayson Waller trades insults with TNA Wrestling stars and AJ Francis
stories.tldr: Newly crowned NXT World Champion Grayson Waller has ignited a war of words with TNA Wrestling by repeatedly disparaging the promotion and its roster, famously dismissing stars like Cruz Montana as merely TNA good. During a recent media appearance, Waller escalated his trash talk by mocking Brian Myers and calling the entire TNA locker room dweebs who only know how to tweet. These remarks prompted swift responses from the promotion, with AJ Francis challenging Waller to a boxing match and KC Navarro offering to settle the score inside a TNA ring.

stories.title: New Owen Hart documentary executive produced by Chris Jericho coming soon
stories.tldr: A new biographical documentary chronicling the life of Owen Hart is preparing for release after receiving a private screening in London during AEW All In weekend. Titled OWEN and a decade in the making, the project features Chris Jericho as an executive producer and a musical score composed by Guns N Roses guitarist Slash. The film has already been sold to HBOs CRAVE streaming service and will soon embark on the film festival circuit. Martha Hart and the Owen Hart Foundation also publicly thanked Tony Khan and AEW for organizing the celebratory red carpet event.

stories.title: Issues and delays reported with Ultra Pro Wrestling video game
stories.tldr: Ultra Pro Wrestling, billed as the spiritual successor to WWF No Mercy, has faced severe development delays, financial disputes, and controversy since its announcement in February 2023. A comprehensive report reveals that publisher Sam Vallely operated as the sole developer, allegedly using extracted animations, unpaid staff, and AI-generated assets while failing to deliver functional builds to investors or promised custom belts to backers. Although Vallely has strongly denied these allegations, citing an acrimonious internal dispute and promising a demo later this year, the project continues to collect nearly 1,000 dollars monthly through an active Patreon campaign.

stories.title: Brawl Under The Bridge wrestling event returning under Ryse banner
stories.tldr: The iconic Pittsburgh independent wrestling event known as Brawl Under The Bridge is officially returning under the Ryse banner on September 19, 2026. Previously run for nine years by the Keystone State Wrestling Alliance beneath the Homestead Grays Bridge before that promotion closed, the unique outdoor show became a beloved community staple. The event famously blends local wrestling history with the rich industrial and baseball heritage of Homestead, Pennsylvania.

stories.title: After Dark Radio episode on UFOs and disclosure
stories.tldr: After Dark Radio with Bryan Alvarez returned with a brand new episode featuring special guest and author Ella LeBain. The discussion focused primarily on the fascinating topics of UFOs and government disclosure. LeBain, known for her books including Who’s Who in the Cosmic Zoo, brought a wealth of subject matter to the table for a fun and engaging conversation. Listeners can access and download the episode directly through the provided audio link.

stories.title: EMERGE Wrestling releases crash course video for new viewers
stories.tldr: EMERGE Wrestling has released an extensive video rundown to help new fans get up to speed ahead of EMERGE 99: Stock The Shelves. The annual event serves as a food drive for the Love Chapel Food Pantry in Columbus, Indiana, offering raffle prizes for fan donations. The crash course video details all eight matches on the card, highlighting key rivalries and championship bouts as the promotion builds toward the historic EMERGE 100.

stories.title: Editorial opinion on the importance and psychology of championship belts
stories.tldr: This editorial examines the vital psychological importance of championship belts in professional wrestling as symbols of skill, struggle, and rich lineage. The author expresses concern over recent trends in WWE, specifically where top stars like Roman Reigns and NXT's Grayson Waller are handed their titles by production assistants rather than carrying them personally. This practice, along with excessive corporate branding, diminishes the prestige of the championships by treating them like disposable props rather than sacred wrestling lore. Ultimately, the piece calls for both wrestlers and television producers to treat these golden trophies with the highest regard to preserve their historical significance.

stories.title: Trey Miguel opens up about battling borderline personality disorder
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling star Trey Miguel has publicly opened up about his battle with borderline personality disorder for the first time in his career. His decision to share the diagnosis came after being inspired by former WWE ID talent Veronica West, who posted about her own mental and physical challenges with BPD. Alongside this diagnosis and his ongoing struggles with depression and anxiety, Miguel recently celebrated a major personal milestone by reaching one year of sobriety.

stories.title: DragonKingKarl concludes NWA World Heavyweight Championship history podcast series
stories.tldr: Wrestling historian Karl Stern has concluded his comprehensive podcast series chronicling the history of the NWA World Heavyweight Championship on the DragonKingKarl Show. This specific installment covers the era when the prestigious championship fell from its status as a major independent title into an obscure lineage featuring wrestlers that fans struggle to remember. Although this chapter of the series wraps up before the modern Billy Corgan-owned NWA era, Stern has indicated that he plans to cover that subsequent period in a future episode. Listeners can access the full audio show by following the subscription link provided by the source.

stories.title: Tyler Breeze Confirms WWE Contract Has Ended, Expresses Interest in AEW
stories.tldr: Tyler Breeze has confirmed on social media that his secondary contract with WWE has officially ended, making him a free agent. The former NXT star, who remained with the company for coaching, promotional work, and the UpUpDownDown YouTube channel following his 2021 release, stated that he would love to join AEW. This development has fueled fan speculation about a potential reunion of the popular gaming group Da Party, especially following the recent AEW debuts of former stablemates Austin Creed and Kofi Kingston.

stories.title: Anthony Bowens' AEW Contract Approaching Expiration
stories.tldr: Anthony Bowens is approaching free agency as his current All Elite Wrestling contract is reportedly set to expire on October 1. As things stand, there has been no indication of a contract extension or whether negotiations have begun between the two sides. His former Acclaimed tag team partner Max Caster is also reportedly under contract through the exact same date. Bowens currently wrestles as part of The Opps stable, following a career that includes reigns as an AEW World Tag Team Champion and World Trios Champion.

stories.title: Nick Comoroto Recalls Spending Years on WWE Waitlist Before Signing With AEW
stories.tldr: During a recent virtual signing, AEW star Nick Comoroto reflected on his lengthy journey to joining WWE. He credited WWE Hall of Famer Gerald Brisco for discovering his athletic background and securing him a tryout. Despite performing well, Comoroto was placed on an internal waiting list for over two and a half years before officially signing in 2019. After a brief NXT run that ended with his release in March 2020 due to budget cuts, he eventually found a new home in AEW and Ring of Honor.

stories.title: Tony Khan Plans Headline Inductee for AEW Hall of Fame
stories.tldr: Ahead of July's AEW Redemption pay-per-view, Tony Khan expressed interest in eventually starting an official All Elite Wrestling Hall of Fame. With the company now celebrating seven years since its inception, speculation is growing about who might lead the inaugural class of inductees. Potential candidates include foundational star Chris Jericho, the late and beloved Mr. Brodie Lee, and legendary icon Sting.

stories.title: The New Level (Kofi Kingston & Austin Creed) Sign With AEW After Leaving WWE
stories.tldr: Following their explosive AEW debut, Kofi and Austin Creed have revealed fresh details regarding their chaotic final hours before All In. The newly minted champions confirmed their new contracts allow for outside-promotion appearances and detailed how a frantic last-minute assist from Big E secured their A$AP Ferg entrance music. Furthermore, the duo clarified that WWE's proposed pay cut was actually steeper than fifty percent.

stories.title: Andrade Criticizes WWE's Treatment and Pay Compared to AEW
stories.tldr: Following his recent success in AEW, Andrade El Idolo opened up about his frustrations with WWE in a candid new interview. He claimed that AEW currently pays him better and treats him well, whereas WWE failed to properly push him or other Mexican talents like Santos Escobar, Angel, and Berto. Additionally, Andrade revealed that his second WWE run was originally built around a planned storyline with his then-wife Charlotte Flair, but her long-term injury and their subsequent divorce derailed those plans and contributed to his exit.

stories.title: The Young Bucks Reflect on Future Retirement and Working With Kenny Omega
stories.tldr: The Young Bucks addressed retirement speculation following their tag team title match at AEW All In, admitting that while they have no official end date, they now approach every match as though it could be their last. Matt Jackson explained that their current focus is navigating one of the most competitive tag divisions in wrestling history against teams like FTR and the Motor City Machine Guns. The brothers also reflected on a poignant backstage moment with Kenny Omega before his main event match against Will Ospreay, knowing that major stadium appearances together may be coming to an end.

stories.title: AEW All In: London 2026 Wembley Stadium Turnstile Attendance Revealed
stories.tldr: Following the recent AEW All In 2026 event at Wembley Stadium, public records obtained from the Brent Council have revealed the official turnstile count. While approximately 47,000 tickets were distributed for the show, actual turnstile data shows that 41,102 fans physically entered the stadium. This figure marks a decline from AEW's previous Wembley events but still solidifies the show as the third-highest attended wrestling event of 2026.

stories.title: Booker T Gives Advice to Sting Following AEW All In Appearance
stories.tldr: At AEW All In, Darby Allin captured the TNT Championship during a chaotic match that brought out retired icon Sting and his son to fend off outside interference. The appearance featured a tense moment where Sting nearly attempted a dangerous ladder dive before his son intervened. Following the event, WWE Hall of Famer Booker T offered some blunt advice to the veteran regarding his continued physical risks.

stories.title: MVP Discusses Heel Psychology and Praises WWE Wellness Program
stories.tldr: Building on his recent comments about modern heel psychology, veteran manager MVP detailed specific dirty tactics he learned from legends like Arn Anderson and William Regal to generate true heat. Furthermore, MVP praised WWE's Wellness Program for eradicating the historical locker room drug culture, noting that it ultimately saved numerous lives. He also revealed that the program personally saved his life by detecting a dangerous heart condition during a routine physical.

stories.title: Carmella Clarifies Retirement Status From Professional Wrestling
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Carmella initially sparked retirement rumors during an appearance on the Hot Mom Shist podcast by stating that she is retired from professional wrestling to focus on motherhood and her family with husband Corey Graves. However, after the comments circulated online, she quickly took to social media to clarify her remarks, stating that her foot is fully healed and she is in the best shape of her life. Carmella ultimately contradicted her own podcast statements by confirming she is definitely not retired, leaving the door open for a potential in-ring return.

stories.title: The Creed Brothers Make Surprise Return to WWE NXT
stories.tldr: The Creed Brothers made a surprise return to WWE NXT by viciously attacking the tag teams of Noam Dar, Romeo Moreno, Dorian Van Dux, and Sean Legacy. The former NXT Tag Team Champions had recently been competing on WWE Main Event and previously performed under masks during the El Grande Americano storyline on the main roster. Brutus and Julius Creed have promised to reveal the motive behind their shocking brand switch on next week's episode. Their arrival immediately injects a heavy dose of power and unpredictability back into the NXT tag team division.

stories.title: Alexa Bliss Suffers Black Eye Injury at Home
stories.tldr: WWE superstar Alexa Bliss suffered a nasty black eye following a freak accident at home when she slipped and hit her eye on a shower handle in the middle of the night. She shared photos of the injury on her Instagram Stories, joking that she woke up like this just days before a major scheduled match. Bliss is currently advertised to team with Charlotte Flair and Tatum Paxley against Jade Cargill, Michin, and B-Fab at WWE Sunday Night’s Main Event. Her immediate medical clearance and participation status for the upcoming September 6 event in Atlanta remain to be officially addressed.

stories.title: Scarlett Bordeaux Reflects on Working With Karrion Kross and Dream Opponents
stories.tldr: Following the expiration of their WWE contracts in 2025, Scarlett Bordeaux and Karrion Kross have transitioned to a busy independent schedule, including appearances in MLW. During a recent interview, Bordeaux reflected on their relationship and career, noting that she never got to wrestle a proper televised singles match during her time with WWE. She also named Lyra Valkyria and Rhea Ripley as her dream opponents for potential future matches.

stories.title: WWE NXT September 1 Episode Reviews and Unaired Matches
stories.tldr: The September 1, 2026 episode of WWE NXT followed the fallout from Heatwave, featuring new champion Grayson Waller and the return of the Creed Brothers alongside the retirement of both WWE Speed titles. Critics had mixed reactions to the booking, questioning Tristan Angels random main event pairing with Zilla Fatu while praising the unique poison mist storyline between Naraku and Shiloh Hill. Meanwhile, live arena fans were treated to three unaired pre-show matches featuring NXT and EVOLVE talent that did not make the broadcast on The CW and Netflix.

stories.title: AJ Styles Discusses WWE Retirement and Lack of Psychology in Wrestling
stories.tldr: AJ Styles recently shared the hidden strategy behind his in-ring retirement following his match against Gunther at the 2026 Royal Rumble, explaining why he opted against dropping his gloves in the ring that night. Having transitioned into a backstage role as a producer and coach for NXT and Evolve following his WWE Hall of Fame induction, Styles is now passing his vast experience to younger talent. In recent discussions, he pointed out a major lack of psychology in modern professional wrestling, arguing that performers rely too heavily on high spots rather than cohesive storytelling. He highlighted recent matches by Brooks Jensen and Rey Fenix as prime examples of how selling and logical pacing can create compelling entertainment without excessive acrobatics.

stories.title: Glenn Jacobs (Kane) Concludes Term as Mayor of Knox County
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Glenn Jacobs, known to wrestling fans as Kane, has officially concluded his eight-year tenure as the mayor of Knox County, Tennessee, due to term limits. Before leaving office, Jacobs made his final official act signing an ordinance that prohibits county government agencies from using automated license plate recognition cameras. He is being succeeded by fellow Republican Betsy Henderson, while his own political future regarding a potential statewide run remains uncertain.

stories.title: AJ Styles Calls Logan Paul WWE's Best Celebrity Athlete
stories.tldr: Former WWE rival AJ Styles recently praised Logan Paul during an appearance on WWE Retrospective, calling him the promotion's greatest celebrity athlete of all time. Styles highlighted Paul's impressive athletic background, relentless work ethic, and dedication both inside and outside the squared circle. The two stars previously shared a heated rivalry that culminated at WrestleMania 41, where Paul ultimately defeated the veteran performer.

stories.title: Mark Henry Defends Nepotism in Professional Wrestling
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Mark Henry recently defended the role of nepotism in professional wrestling during an interview. He argued that second- and third-generation wrestlers possess a distinct advantage because they understand industry culture, terminology, and travel demands from an early age. Henry cited successful stars like Charlotte Flair, Randy Orton, Cody Rhodes, and Dominik Mysterio as prime examples of this benefit. Furthermore, he noted that his own son, Jacob Henry, would similarly benefit from the family name if he enters the business due to established industry respect and shared professional values.

stories.title: WWE Preparing Upcoming Heel Turns for Major Stars
stories.tldr: WWE is reportedly preparing several major roster members for potential heel turns as the company approaches a busy schedule of major shows in September. Seeds have already been planted for babyfaces like Damian Priest, Tony D'Angelo, and Tiffany Stratton to undergo character shifts. These changes could manifest soon through tag team tensions, main roster transitions, or betrayals between allies.

stories.title: Former WWE Stars Re-Signing With NXT Roster
stories.tldr: As NXT continues to bring in new talent and returning alumni in 2026, rumors are circulating about several former WWE stars potentially re-signing with the developmental brand. Names like Eric Young, Mara Sade, and Enzo Amore have all been linked to potential returns in player-coach or full-time roles. While nothing is officially confirmed for all candidates, these prospective additions could bring valuable experience and unfinished business back to the Florida-based show.

stories.title: WWE Formally Retires Men's and Women's Speed Championships on NXT
stories.tldr: Following her title unification win at NXT Heatwave, Zaria officially chose to keep the Women's North American Championship on the September 1 episode of NXT. This decision forced the retirement of the Women's Speed Championship and prompted General Manager Robert Stone to declare the men's Speed Championship defunct as well. Men's champion Lexis King was forced to begrudgingly relinquish his title alongside his Birthright stablemates, effectively bringing the entire Speed era in WWE to a close.

stories.title: Dexter Lumis Details WWE Career, Wyatt Sicks Role, and Pitch for Brock Lesnar
stories.tldr: Beyond the initial creative plans for the Wyatt Sicks, Dexter Lumis recently shared extensive details about his WWE career, including his silent character inspiration, his on-screen romance with Indi Hartwell, and a direct pitch to Paul Heyman for a match against Brock Lesnar. He also discussed his tag team run and title reign with Joe Gacy, as well as his appearance transformations. Finally, Lumis reflected on his past releases and how corporate priorities under TKO differ from Triple H's creative philosophy.

stories.title: Bronson Reed Expected to Make WWE Return This Month
stories.tldr: Following months of recovery from a torn bicep, Bronson Reed is fully healthy and expected to return to WWE television this September. He is slated to rejoin the Raw roster full-time as a top-level heel, potentially integrating back into his faction, The Vision. Speculation suggests his comeback could happen as early as Sunday Night's Main Event during the match between Bron Breakker and Oba Femi.

stories.title: Matches and Segments Announced for September 8 WWE NXT
stories.tldr: Following recent Heatwave fallout, WWE has finalized the lineup for the September 8 episode of NXT featuring multiple championship defenses and high-stakes tournament implications. Newly crowned NXT Women's Champion Kelani Jordan will put her title on the line against Jaida Parker, while North American Champion Jackson Drake defends against Tavion Heights. Additionally, six top contenders will battle in a massive six-man tag team match to determine who advances toward a future NXT Championship opportunity against Grayson Waller.

stories.title: Kendal Grey Out of Action Following NXT Heatwave
stories.tldr: Following her championship defense at NXT Heatwave, former titleholder Kendal Grey has been officially sidelined for the foreseeable future. Grey dropped the NXT Women's Championship to Kelani Jordan, ending her 63-day reign. Medical evaluations on television revealed she is suffering from vertigo and a vestibular disruption due to impacts sustained during the match, though concussions have been ruled out.

stories.title: Royce Keys and OTM's Violent Attack Angle Opens WWE Raw
stories.tldr: Following their brutal parking lot assault on The Usos and Solo Sikoa, Royce Keys and OTM are drawing widespread industry praise for their unique gang-like intensity. Triple H subsequently released uncensored footage of the carnage after broadcast networks blurred the heavy bleeding. Analysts speculate the storyline is building toward a massive WarGames match at Survivor Series uniting The Bloodline against Keys, OTM, and partners, while Penta also secured an upcoming title match against Roman Reigns in Mexico City.

stories.title: Alexa Bliss and Charlotte Flair Pitch for WWE Tag Team Storyline
stories.tldr: Building on their successful tag team run that captured the WWE Women's Tag Team Championships at SummerSlam 2026, Alexa Bliss has shared further details on how the alliance has allowed both wrestlers to showcase new sides of their personalities. Meanwhile, Charlotte Flair has also expressed interest in exploring a completely different type of television program by pitching an on-screen romantic storyline to show a more vulnerable and flirty side of her character.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes and Roman Reigns Featured in Live-Action Street Fighter Trailer
stories.tldr: Cody Rhodes and Roman Reigns take center stage in the new live-action Street Fighter movie trailer, showcasing their respective transformations as Guile and Akuma ahead of the film's October 16 release. The star-studded video game adaptation also features NJPW star Hirooki Goto as E. Honda alongside a massive Hollywood cast. Meanwhile, Rhodes is preparing to face Randy Orton in a WrestleMania rematch at this weekend's Sunday Night Main Event in Atlanta.

stories.title: WWE Views Crowd Response to AAA and NXT Doubleheader as Eye-Opener
stories.tldr: WWE officials reportedly viewed the crowd response to the recent AAA and NXT doubleheader in Texas as a major eye-opener. Because NXT is typically the larger brand in the United States, WWE scheduled it after AAA, leading to a heavy mass exodus of fans before the NXT Heatwave main event. Backstage feedback noted that AAA lucha libre stars were far more over with the heavily Hispanic audience than the NXT roster, save for Zilla Fatu. Moving forward, company sources indicate that WWE has learned it should run NXT first if they attempt a similar format again.

stories.title: Austin Creed Discusses Emotional Impact of The New Day Split
stories.tldr: Austin Creed recently opened up about the personal and professional hurdles that led to his and Kofi Kingston's departure from WWE. Creed revealed that an awkward kayfabe encounter at WrestleMania left his three-year-old son confused as to why Big E was ignoring them, prompting a realization that the storyline had gone too far. Additionally, the duo decided to walk away after being approached with contract renegotiations that included a fifty percent pay cut and reduced roles.

stories.title: WWE Raw Viewership Notes for Netflix Era
stories.tldr: Following recent broadcast censorship issues, new metrics have been released detailing viewing trends for the streaming era. The August 24 episode of WWE Raw experienced a slight decline in viewership, pulling in 2.5 million global views and 4.4 million hours viewed. Despite the dip, the show remained a top ten fixture in 16 countries and seventh in the U.S. Featured segments on the card included an Oba Femi and Bron Breakker contract signing, Stephanie Vaquer's return match, and tournament semifinals.

stories.title: Zilla Fatu Rejects Recruitment Offer From BirthRight on NXT
stories.tldr: Following his heartbreaking loss at NXT Heatwave, Zilla Fatu bounced back by defeating Tristan Angels in a hard-fought singles match on the September 1 episode of NXT. However, his night took another dramatic turn when the faction BirthRight attempted to recruit him into their ranks. Fatu swiftly rejected the offer with a definitive answer and a superkick to Lexis King, making it clear he intends to forge his own path.

stories.title: Shawn Michaels Discusses NXT Challenges and Upcoming Championship Holders
stories.tldr: Following a massive wave of roster changes and call-ups, Shawn Michaels credited recent major acquisitions like Grayson Waller, Cruz Montana, and Zilla Fatu with revitalizing the brand. In the wake of the recent Heatwave event, attention has now turned toward the future picture for NXT championships. Analysts and observers are mapping out potential upcoming titleholders across the men's and women's divisions, including projected reigns for Cruz Montana, Kendal Grey, and others.

stories.title: Myles Borne Speaks Out on Turning Heel at NXT Heatwave
stories.tldr: Following his devastating championship losses and shocking heel turn on Tavion Heights at NXT Heatwave, Myles Borne has broken his silence on social media. In a video posted to X, Borne admitted that he has re-watched his attack on Heights numerous times and expressed that while the situation sucks, he has no regrets about taking the initiative. Borne justified his betrayal by claiming he saw warning signs and chose to strike first out of self-preservation before Heights could turn on him.

stories.title: Jade Cargill Calls Out Male Wrestling Fans on Social Media
stories.tldr: Following her recent announcement about bringing back the Baddie Section, Jade Cargill sparked a major social media controversy. She lashed out at male wrestling fans by calling them overgrown and sloppy men while expressing a preference for attractive women in the audience. Cargill aggressively defended her remarks against heavy backlash, arguing with critics and claiming a large portion of her fanbase does not even watch wrestling.

stories.title: WWE Title Change Plans Ahead of Money in the Bank 2026
stories.tldr: As the road to Money in the Bank continues, creative plans are pointing toward several major championship changes across WWE and AAA. Trick Williams is positioned to challenge Baron Corbin for the United States Championship following a unique stipulation involving Lil Yachty at Sunday Night's Main Event. Meanwhile, El Grande Americano is heavily favored to dethrone Dominik Mysterio for the AAA Mega Championship at TripleMania 34. Additionally, Sami Zayn is gunning to recapture the Undisputed WWE Championship from CM Punk after weeks of chaotic main event interference.

stories.title: The Bryan & Vinny Show Mid-South Wrestling 1984 Retrospective
stories.tldr: The latest episode of The Bryan and Vinny Show features a mix of personal updates and classic wrestling review. The hosts spend time trying to cheer up Granny and providing customer service for his new computer, alongside discussions about Facebook, soap operas, wrestling reports, and trivia. Afterward, they dive into the retro review by breaking down an episode of Mid-South Wrestling from the week of November 2, 1984.

stories.title: Analysis of Frozen Contracts in Professional Wrestling
stories.tldr: Major professional wrestling promotions like WWE, AEW, and TNA utilize contract freezing clauses to extend a wrestler's agreement by adding time missed due to injuries, pregnancy, or other approved absences. While talents continue to receive their guaranteed salary during this period, the countdown to free agency is paused, preventing them from signing elsewhere or taking unauthorized outside bookings. Real-world examples involving performers like Carmella, Adam Copeland, and Danhausen highlight how companies exercise these options differently, sparking ongoing debate about whether wrestlers should have a say in extending their expiration dates.

stories.title: BJ Bethel Addresses Twitter Absence Following ESPN Story Controversy
stories.tldr: Former wrestling reporter BJ Bethel has resurfaced on Bluesky to address his sudden Twitter silence following the fallout from a retracted report regarding ESPN and WWE. Bethel claims he still stands by his discredited story and stopped posting on Twitter due to attempted hacking that conveniently began on the exact day ESPN denied his claims. However, he provided zero evidence of these security breaches, leaving many skeptical about the true reason for his disappearance. His former employer previously fired him and retracted the story in full after admitting proper verification standards were not met.

stories.title: Matt Hardy Shares Thoughts on TNA Environment
stories.tldr: Matt Hardy recently discussed the different creative environments of major wrestling promotions on his podcast, comparing TNA, AEW, and WWE. He noted that while AEW offers immense creative freedom, it sometimes lacks necessary restraint, whereas WWE tends to overproduce its television segments. According to Hardy, TNA successfully strikes the ideal balance between the two by giving talent enough autonomy to succeed without letting them run completely wild.

stories.title: Pro Wrestling Thunder Launches New YouTube Channel
stories.tldr: Indiana-based promotion Pro Wrestling Thunder has launched a new YouTube channel to expand its digital footprint and reach fans outside its local market. The channel will showcase the promotion's blend of established regional talent and nationally experienced wrestlers, such as Kongo Kong, Erik Surge, Ashton Adonis, Jake Omen, and Elijah Eros. This new platform aims to give both loyal followers and newcomers an accessible entry point to watch events, follow ongoing storylines, and discover the local independent wrestling scene in northeastern Indiana.

stories.title: SB Nation Launches New Cageside Seats Mobile App
stories.tldr: Pro wrestling fans now have a dedicated mobile application designed to improve how they follow and discuss WWE, AEW, and other grappling promotions. The platform offers enhanced community tools, push notifications for replies and recommendations, and a smoother live blogging experience for game threads. Users will also benefit from fewer advertisements and a centralized feed that keeps all their favorite discussions in one place. The application is available now for download on both iOS and Android devices through their respective app stores.

stories.title: Tessa Blanchard Officially Signs With MLW
stories.tldr: Following earlier teasers, Tessa Blanchard has officially signed with Major League Wrestling. She announced her arrival during a TMZ interview, revealing she plans to become the franchise player of the women's division and challenge champion Shotzi Blackheart. MLW subsequently confirmed that Blanchard will make her promotional debut on September 12 at Fightland in Charleston, South Carolina. Her signing is facilitated by her ongoing relationship with CMLL, which stems from her recent departure from TNA over scheduling conflicts.

stories.title: Cauliflower Alley Club Defends Ric Flair After Las Vegas No-Show
stories.tldr: Ric Flair is aggressively tracking down missing wrestling robes, recently accusing his ex-wife of theft and warning unauthorized sellers that memorabilia theft is a felony. Meanwhile, the Cauliflower Alley Club has defended honoring Flair after fans grew angry over his Las Vegas no-show due to blood clots. To make up for his physical absence, the organization brought in Jerry Lawler on short notice and hosted Flair's first-ever virtual appearance. Flair later explained that skipping Vegas allowed him to make a scheduled appearance in Philadelphia instead.

stories.title: Matt Cardona's Future in Professional Wrestling
stories.tldr: Following his recent triceps recovery, Matt Cardona's broader career trajectory highlights a remarkable post-WWE reinvention. While many released talent struggle outside the company or simply coast on past television exposure, Cardona completely overhauled his persona. He successfully broke away from the safe, corporate Zack Ryder mold to become an independent wrestling powerhouse willing to take massive risks, including high-profile death matches.

stories.title: Zoey Serrano Addresses Injury History and In-Ring Style
stories.tldr: Following her recent TNA debut and name change, Zoey Serrano is making significant adjustments to her in-ring style. Having dealt with multiple knee injuries, including a severe one in May 2025 from a springboard maneuver, she has decided to retire her high-flying moves. During a recent interview, Serrano explained that her feet will stay firmly on the ground for this TNA run as she shapes her new persona.
